title: 2022, City Council Board of Canvassers Meeting Agenda

votes.motion: Council Member Gaston moved to approve Resolution No. 2022-50, Certifying the Canvass of the Official Election Results for the Bluffdale Tax Referendum. Council Member Aston seconded the motion
Council Member Crockett moved to ADJOURN. Council Member Aston seconded the motion
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Council
